observations: body L1: in the Persian, «سياره‌را» is printed with the hāʾ in its separate form directly before «را», as with a zero-width non-joiner, and is so transcribed; the gāf of «ديڭررا» is the kāf with three dots and the final yāʾ of «فلكى» has no dots, as on p. 335. The dots of «كه ...» are printed spaced; transcribed «...».
body L7, L19, L35: the vowel above the shadda of «الشُّجَاعُ» (L7), «جَنُوبِيُّ» (L19) and «الشُّعْبَتَيْنِ» (L35) is the damma laid flat over the shadda (a head with a tail), not a fatha.
body L8: the kasra of the final nūn of «الشَّرَطَانِ» touches the bowl of the letter; a speck (0.8 point) is printed beside the dot of the nūn; not transcribed.
body L9: the sukūn of the shīn of «أَشْرَافٌ» touches the fatha of the rāʾ.
body L10, L24: the second and the third digit of «٢٤٤» (L10) are the 4 (the 2 and the first 4 touch, 6.6 points; the last 4 is 3.7 points); «٢٩» (L24) has two digits.
body L14, L37: «وقد» (L14) and the first «طرف» (L37) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
body L15, L23: «hortus» (L15, L23) is printed with an initial h; transcribed as printed.

body L18, L19: no dash is printed before «وَسَطُ» (L18) or «جَنُوبِيُّ» (L19); the Arabic follows the full stop. «التَّشْرِيقِ» (L19) has a kasra under the rāʾ, printed low, and one under the qāf; «التَّشْرِيق» (L18) has only the kasra of the rāʾ.
body L22, L23: «μερινή» (L22) is printed with the acute before «ἀνατολή», unlike «χειμερινὴ» and «ϑερινὴ» (L23); transcribed as printed.
body L32: the shīn of «شُِعَاعَهُ» has a damma above and a kasra below; both are transcribed. The final hamza of «إِلْقَاءٌ» is the sort with the dammatan (5.0 by 5.9 points).
body L37: «piumbeum» is printed with an i, dot included, where the word has an l; transcribed as printed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
